csv_project_name: Consultant for STH 23 Lower Wyoming Road Replacement
csv_agency: State of Wisconsin Dept of Trans Div Of Hwys
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Wisconsin , Department of Transportation , may be seeking a Consultant for Perpetuation project to resurface approximately 6.3 miles of STH 23 from CTH ZZ to Lower Wyoming Road in Iowa County. Resurface the roadway, update beam guard as needed, replace or repair culverts as necessary, improve intersection safety at STH 130 and address maintenance needs on B-25-0078. Ten culvert replacements are anticipated. The intersection improvement at STH 23 and STH 130 is anticipated to include adding a dedicated left turn lane from STH 23. The anticipated structure work on B-25-0078, pedestrian structure over STH 23, includes replacement of pedestrian fencing/ railing, applying a methacrylate flood seal to the deck and spot painting associated with fence installation.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Sanitation Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering
